da-non-sequitur.evidence: Lean is extensionality on the fields; it has no gauge and no c₂. Classically false: charge-1 SU(2) instantons on S⁴ form a 5-dimensional moduli space (dim 8k−3, Atiyah–Hitchin–Singer 1978), so two instantons of equal charge need not be gauge-equivalent. "ℳ_k parameterised by H⁴" is a category error.

trap-meta-commentary.evidence: no meta-commentary on the block's own rhetoric

Opens with the same templated proof-strategy preamble as the sibling exists-proof: 'The proof strategy uses characteristic classes and gauge equivalence. We demonstrate that the second Chern class $c_2$ completely classifies the solutions up to gauge transformations. Consequently, any two instantons with the same $c_2$ coincide, and the moduli space of solutions is faithfully parameterized by $H^4$.' Sentences 2-3 restate the proposition verbatim before any argument is given; the body never mentions characteristic classes beyond re-using $c_2$ as a hypothesis. Spelling gives the preamble away as separately generated: 'parameterized' here vs 'parameterised' in the proposition .md it is attached to.
trap-meta-commentary.notes: Proposed (structural, paragraph removal, uniform across the chapter): delete the preamble; the body is the proof. If retained, cut to the single non-redundant clause and match the chapter's -ise spelling.
